Subject: [FoRK] Tagmindr:  another cool delicious hack / tool


There's a really powerful idea lurking here that I'm hard pressed to  
define concisely and unambiguously;  but I think the whole notion of  
what I'm calling "open tagging", structured tags (i.e., both  
attributes and values, cf. the remind: tag below), universal feeds,  
and so on --- are creating something really interesting.  Here's one  
that's immediately useful (though I wish Values of N's Sandy spoke  
delicious, it would obviate the need for this!)

   http://tagmindr.com/

This gives you a "reminder feed" that's a filtered subset of your  
delicious feed.  Simply tag items (bookmarked to your delicious feed)  
with tagmindr and remind:YYYY-MM-DD to add to your reminders feed,  
and they then show up in the later feed on the indicated date.   
Bookmarks to the future!

jb
